title: An agent filing a task always says why it matters
description: Every task an agent files from a Claude Code session (the `10db-task` skill in packages/agent-skill) should carry a one-sentence why. `create` should refuse a draft without one (`draftProblems` in packages/agent-skill/src/task-checks.ts), so the agent writes it before the task reaches the board. The in-app chat and the builder MCP's `create_task` (packages/contracts/src/builder-mcp-tools.ts, docs/builder-mcp.md) should be told to write a why on every task, without refusing a task that has none. The New Task form and the API still treat why as optional. Update the skill's SKILL.md and the package's AGENTS.md to say why is always written and why the skill is stricter than the form.
acceptanceCriteria: The skill's create refuses a draft with a missing or blank why, with table rows for both
The builder MCP's drafting guidance asks for a why on every task
The New Task form and the API still accept a task with no why
The real-daemon skill API tests draft tasks that carry a why
